halal.title: This ingredient is considered permitted under Islamic Law.
halal.what_detected: Ingredient classified as halal. See BOTIA Note below for details.
halal.why_it_matters: Halal food must not contain anything unlawful under Islamic Law, and must not have been in contact with non-halal substances during preparation or processing.
halal.what_it_cannot_conclude: BOTIA signals ingredient classification only — not halal certification, slaughter method, or facility conditions.
halal.source_note: Codex Alimentarius CAC/GL 24-1997 · OIC/SMIIC 1:2019 · Learn more at botia-safefood.com

mashbooh.title: This ingredient is of uncertain origin under Islamic Law.
mashbooh.what_detected: Ingredient detected whose halal status cannot be confirmed from the label alone. See BOTIA Note below for details.
mashbooh.why_it_matters: Under Islamic Law, food additives derived from unlawful sources are also unlawful (Codex CAC/GL 24-1997). However, food labels worldwide do not require declaring the origin of many ingredients — flavourings, emulsifiers, enzymes, and gelatins may come from animal, plant, or alcohol-based sources without this being visible on the label.
mashbooh.what_it_cannot_conclude: BOTIA cannot confirm or deny halal status. It signals that the origin is undeclared — the decision belongs to you and your religious authority.
mashbooh.source_note: Codex Alimentarius CAC/GL 24-1997 · OIC/SMIIC 1:2019 · Learn more at botia-safefood.com

haram.title: This product contains an ingredient forbidden under Islamic Law.
haram.what_detected: Ingredient classified as Haram detected. See BOTIA Note below for details.
haram.why_it_matters: Under Islamic Law, certain sources are explicitly forbidden — including pork and its derivatives, alcohol, blood, and food additives derived from any of these sources (Codex CAC/GL 24-1997). When BOTIA classifies an ingredient as Haram, the origin is clear and declared on the label.
haram.what_it_cannot_conclude: BOTIA signals presence only. It cannot issue a religious ruling or replace a certified Halal authority.
haram.source_note: Codex Alimentarius CAC/GL 24-1997 · OIC/SMIIC 1:2019 · Learn more at botia-safefood.com
